title: 完整语言和错误反馈 (full language and error feedback)
notes: Synthetic/in-memory widget + unit tests only; no native library, kernel, port, host proxy/TUN/registry or user data touched.
Port 10808 never used; no listener opened by this card's tests.
Release build produced build/windows/x64/runner/Release/v2rayn_desktop.exe; no project instance held the exe lock.
Real DPI/RTL screenshot matrix and real sub-engine locale binding are NOT verified here (see gaps).

commands.result: The only issue is a pre-existing unused import in test/repair/r4_18_p09_repro_test.dart (another card's file, untouched). No R4-30 warning/error.
6/6 passed (pre-fix: exit 1, compile/behavior failure; see repro-prefix.log)
768 passed, 2 pending; all 49 failures were the documented batch 'did not complete' flakes with zero real assertion failures; affected files pass when run alone.

gaps.issue: The independent settings-window engine does not bind productLanguageProvider or register kL10nDelegate, so it renders the scope-less zh-Hans default instead of the main window's active language. UFS-13/D36 owns the sub-engine presentation config.
gaps.impact: Sub-window language does not follow the main setting until R4-11/R4-12 wire the presentation snapshot.

gaps.issue: SettingsApplyOutcome.message and SettingsEditorOutcome.message embed the raw error.messageKey inside Chinese human text (e.g. '配置已保存，但应用失败：error.runtime_timeout'); the window cannot fully de-keyify a composed message without changing the producer.
gaps.impact: The composed apply-failure banner still contains an embedded contract token; headline is readable, token would need producer-side localization.

gaps.issue: AppMenuEntry.label keeps the frozen zh-Hans source string for stable test keys; only labelFor(l10n) returns the localized text.
gaps.impact: None functionally; documented so a future card does not treat label as the visible text.
